smallest_justified_next_cut.decision: Do not broaden the three-file group patch as the historical answer. The evidenced smallest next cut is an exact session-local routing/target selector over the existing DirectEstateI03Session/members index, not a new backend and not a new evaluator.
smallest_justified_next_cut.why: It addresses the repeated routing/object materialization for changing targets/predicates that the old wide prepared substrate avoided, while preserving the current 13-family estate, authority closure, CURRENT checks, exact facts and replay.
smallest_justified_next_cut.surface: DirectEstateI03Session / existing SQLite members index and _ReleaseIndex routing access; exact keys from release/universe, respondent, target and risk set; no arbitrary query/result cache.
what_it_does_not_do: does not recreate a persistent country substrate
does not cache facts, weighted values, member refs, replay or output
does not make different predicates/targets share a statistical core
does not establish old V550/V550J product parity
smallest_justified_next_cut.alternative_if_required: A persistent prepared country/respondent substrate is a larger architecture/semantics decision and is NOT_ESTABLISHED as current implementation.
